tier: Free one-time $5 compute credit (Small and Large VMs)

free_tier.stated: $5 compute credit, valid for 14 days, added when you sign up, one per person, cannot pay the Starter subscription fee; no credit card required, with the BoxCompute agent's daily AI allowance and two VMs and two chats at once
free_tier.notes: A one-time credit, not a recurring allowance: 'Credit is added when you sign up. It doesn't renew.' At about $0.05/hour for a Small VM the credit is roughly 100 Small-VM hours, and at about $0.15/hour for a Large VM roughly 33 Large-VM hours, while the VM runs.

per_object_cap.stated: files kept in Assets stay after a VM is deleted, up to 5 GiB each; no storage limit on any plan
per_object_cap.notes: The cap is per file in Assets, not a total account cap.

retention.stated: a VM keeps its workspace files when it stops; a VM stops after 30 minutes idle and its files stay; files saved to Assets stay after a VM is deleted, with no storage limit on any plan

egress.terms: not published as a per-GB price: a VM's running time is billed by the second, including idle time; web apps get preview links and database clients need TCP access that depends on the deployment. No outbound byte allowance or price per GB is stated on the pricing page.

interface_detail: MCP server at https://mcp.boxcompute.ai/mcp for Claude, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; an HTTP API and SDKs; a CLI with a coding-agent skill; and a browser chat agent with live preview links. VMs are full Ubuntu/Linux machines with their own kernel.
tooling: MCP client, HTTP API, SDKs and CLI; the browser chat agent runs the VM in the cloud, so the user needs only a browser. No rclone backend exists for its Assets store; that is a tooling note, not a verdict.
chaining: A one-time $5 credit buys a few tens of hours of Small or Large Linux VMs for agent work; the agent connects through MCP using the user's own model key, so the BoxCompute credit pays only VM time, and files that must outlive a VM go to Assets before deletion.

limits.value: $5 compute credit valid 14 days, one per person; two concurrent VMs and two chats on free, three with pay-as-you-go credit
a VM stops after 30 minutes idle and keeps its files; running time bills per second with a one-minute minimum, stopped VMs cost nothing

limits_note: VM sizes: Small 0.5 vCPU/1 GiB RAM about $0.05/hour; Large 1.5 vCPU/3 GiB RAM about $0.15/hour; XL 4 vCPU/8 GiB and XXL 4-8 vCPU/16 GiB about $0.40 or $0.80/hour on Starter. Hosted in Cyberjaya, Malaysia; VM sandboxes are in beta.
binding_note: The $5 credit is one-time and expires after 14 days, so it runs out first; the 30-minute idle stop keeps an unattended VM from draining it.
